TUN.note: Document concerns open data and a consultation; no government transaction service is named.

facts.fact: Tunisia's E-Government Unit, with the PAGOF programme, ran an online questionnaire for the public from 19 March to 20 April 2025 on the national strategy for opening and reusing public data.
facts.system: Online survey on national open data strategy

facts.fact: The OGP Tunisia notice describes the national portal data.gov.tn as a major advance, interconnected with several sector portals.

systems.owner: E-Government Unit, Presidency of the Government

facts.fact: Tunisia's E-Government Unit, with PAGOF, put an online questionnaire to the public and data reusers from 19 March to 20 April 2025 as part of drawing up the national strategy on opening and reusing public data.

TUN.note: Decree 2021-03 and circular 4 of 2024 are named as the framework but no consultation is said to be required by them.
